statement: The current-source focused release suite passes47 tests. New checks compare direct parsing against the original BigUint grammar over word/inline/heap boundaries, validate every byte at each eight-digit SIMD position, and check all53248 two/three-limb basis products with nonzero XOR accumulators and short-output safety. Existing field, trace-zero context, compact workspace and projector checks also pass. Producer-written checks, unsigned; no performance result yet.
